intent: Handle only observed HTTP 429 before a pinned candidate artifact response is opened, with finite attempts and waits respecting Retry-After; retain HTTPS, transfer size, SHA256, publisher SHA1, atomic publication and every native build/ELF check.

observedFailure.stage: checked_download called from Maven artifact loop

independentReview.initialFinding: permissive email date parsing accepted trailing, coalesced or unknown-zone hints
independentReview.correction: Require full canonical HTTP-date round trip; all11 controls pass

behavior.otherErrors: no retry for other HTTP status, transport, body, integrity or native build failure
behavior.transport: same pinned HTTPS URL; no source mirror or unpinned fallback
behavior.publisherChecks: Existing size, SHA256, optional SHA1, partial cleanup and atomic replacement unchanged

limits: The original hosted log does not identify which Maven artifact returned429 or expose its Retry-After value.
Bounded recovery can still refuse a long cooldown or exhaust three attempts; final CI must establish a successful candidate.
Source/host controls do not establish native build, device performance or release publication.
All existing input pins, native-build suffix, workflow gates, Gateway payload and release versions remain unchanged.
